description: Redo the model selector dropdown's interaction layer: migrate the shared ModelSelect and the bespoke IssueModelSelector default-model popover onto a single cmdk-based list primitive so selection happens on click (not pointerdown), touch/pen scrolling is restored, scroll is contained, provider headers stay sticky, keyboard navigation is complete, and combobox/listbox semantics are exposed consistently across all four model-selection surfaces.

tasks.title: Shared cmdk-based ModelOptionList primitive + port ModelSelect to click-to-select
tasks.spec: specs/model-select/spec.md#Selection happens on confirmation, not on press
tasks.description: Introduce one internal shared component (working name `ModelOptionList`) under `packages/web/src/shared/ui/` that wraps the already-installed cmdk `Command`/`CommandInput`/`CommandList`/`CommandEmpty`/`CommandGroup`/`CommandItem` primitives and owns: overscroll containment on the list (`overscroll-y-contain`, replacing the wrapped `CommandList`'s `no-scrollbar` default in `command.tsx:113` so a visible scrollbar returns), sticky provider group headings via `[[cmdk-group-heading]]:sticky [[cmdk-group-heading]]:top-0 [[cmdk-group-heading]]:z-10 [[cmdk-group-heading]]:bg-muted`, the chip-inside-`CommandItem` pattern (chip clicks/keydown isolated by the existing `stopPropagation` on `ModelVariantChips` at `ModelSelect.tsx:72,87-93`), the `data-model-id` test hook, and empty/loading/error placeholders. Then port `packages/web/src/shared/ui/ModelSelect.tsx` onto it: render provider-grouped models via `CommandGroup` (heading = provider), use cmdk's built-in fuzzy filter (drop the hand-rolled substring filter at `ModelSelect.tsx:167-173`), move selection to `CommandItem.onSelect` (click) plus chip-scoped `onKeyDown` for →/Tab/←/Enter, and DELETE the #113 workaround — the native `pointerdown` delegation listener and its ref-callback lifecycle (`ModelSelect.tsx:209-254, 233-254`), the redundant per-row `onClick` (`ModelSelect.tsx:423`), and the `highlightedIndex`/`chipFocus` state plus `handleKeyDown`/`handleChipKeyDown` (`ModelSelect.tsx:160-161, 266-333`) since cmdk now provides ↑/↓/Home/End/Enter/type-ahead/scroll-into-view and the listbox/combobox roles natively. Preserve the #288 semantics in the model `onSelect` (body select clears any prior variant via `onChangeVariant?.(null)`). The `ModelSelectProps` contract (`onChange`/`onChangeVariant`/`onChangeModelVariant`/`modelVariants`/`valueVariant`/`size`/`id`/`aria-labelledby`/`allowClear`/`onClear`) is unchanged so the three direct consumers — `pages/settings/ui/AiSettingsSection.tsx` (default + per-stage), `features/create-issue/ui/CreateIssueDialog.tsx`, `widgets/agent-profile-editor/ui/AgentProfileEditor.tsx` — and the per-stage rows inside `IssueModelSelector.tsx` (`size="compact"`) inherit the new interaction with zero prop edits. Update `packages/web/src/shared/ui/ModelSelect.test.tsx` in the same task.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the ModelSelect popover and `fireEvent.click`-ing an option invokes `onChange` with that model id and closes the popover; `fireEvent.pointerDown` on an option no longer selects (the native pointerdown delegation listener and the per-row onClick/onPointerDown are gone).
A mouse press that starts on an option and releases after moving off it does NOT invoke `onChange` and the popover stays open (press-move-release no-select scenario).

No selection logic in `ModelSelect.tsx` is bound to `pointerdown` or `touchstart`, and no pointer-event handler calls `preventDefault()`/`stopPropagation()` on the list — touch/pen scroll initiation is no longer cancelled by selection code.

The option list container exposes `role="listbox"`; each option exposes `role="option"`; the option matching the current `value` exposes `aria-selected="true"` and every other option exposes `aria-selected="false"`; the combobox input exposes `aria-controls`/`aria-expanded` and updates `aria-activedescendant` when the active option changes (asserted via jsdom).

Keyboard navigation works end-to-end without hand-rolled state: ↑/↓ move the active option and scroll it into view, `Home`/`End` jump to the first/last filtered option, `Enter` selects the active model (default variant), `Escape` closes without changing selection, typing filters the list.

Clicking a variant chip selects model + variant together (atomic `onChangeModelVariant` when provided, else `onChange`+`onChangeVariant`); clicking a model row body selects the model with the default (no) variant and clears any prior variant; `stopPropagation` on the chip keeps the chip click from also triggering the item body.

Chip keyboard flow still works: → or `Tab` from a highlighted variant-capable model row moves focus into the chip set; `ArrowLeft` at the first chip returns focus to the list; `Enter` on a focused chip selects model + that variant.

The `CommandList` className includes `overscroll-y-contain` (scroll containment) and the `CommandGroup` heading className includes the sticky/top-0/z-10/bg-muted utilities (sticky provider headers), asserted via jsdom className checks.

Options render with a pointer cursor and a hover visual state distinct from the resting state; the selected model row renders with a visual indication distinct from non-selected rows; variant chip layout does not compress the option row below its standard hit height.

`ModelSelect.test.tsx` is updated: existing `fireEvent.pointerDown(row)` selection assertions flip to `fireEvent.click(row)`; new cases cover press-move-release no-select, `Home`/`End`, Escape-closes, `role="listbox"`/`role="option"`/`aria-selected`/`aria-activedescendant`, chip-click `stopPropagation`, and the overscroll-contain + sticky-heading classNames.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` pass, including the pre-existing `describeModel` and trigger-display cases.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/shared/ui/ModelOptionList.tsx (new internal component); packages/web/src/shared/ui/ModelSelect.tsx (rewritten onto cmdk + ModelOptionList, pointerdown workaround and hand-rolled keyboard state deleted); packages/web/src/shared/ui/ModelSelect.test.tsx (flipped + new cases).
tasks.notes: This task delivers the canonical click-to-select/scroll-contained/sticky-header/keyboard-complete/accessible implementation and automatically fixes every shared-ModelSelect consumer — Settings AI default + per-stage, Create Issue dialog, Agent Profile editor, AND the per-stage rows inside IssueModelSelector (which consume `ModelSelect` with `size="compact"`). Do NOT touch the bespoke IssueModelSelector default-model popover here — that is T-002. cmdk selects on `onClick` only (verified against its compiled output: no `onPointerDown`/`preventDefault`), so it inherently satisfies the spec's 'SHALL NOT register selection logic on pointerdown'. The current base-ui (^1.5.0) no longer dismisses the popover before click fires (#113 timing bug gone), so `onSelect` reaches the handler; a regression test asserting click-selection inside the open popover is the mitigation called out in design.md Risks. Roles/aria come from cmdk natively — pass `aria-labelledby` (the existing trigger label) and a meaningful `aria-label` through to `CommandInput`. Reuse `shared/ui/model-variants.ts` unchanged.

tasks.title: Port IssueModelSelector default-model popover onto the shared ModelOptionList
tasks.spec: specs/model-select/spec.md#Selection result and interaction are identical across all model-selection surfaces
tasks.description: Replace the bespoke default-model list inside `packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.tsx` with the shared `ModelOptionList` from T-001 so the Issue detail default-model popover inherits identical click-to-select, scroll-contained, sticky-header, keyboard-complete, combobox-semantics behavior. Render the popover's existing sections (Override / Recent / All models) as `CommandGroup`s through the shared component; keep `filter={false}` on the cmdk root and continue driving the list with the existing `fuzzysort` result (`IssueModelSelector.tsx:240-244`) so search quality on this surface does not regress. DELETE the bespoke `ModelListItem`'s inline `onPointerDown` selector (`IssueModelSelector.tsx:154-159`) and the bespoke `handleKeyDown` (`IssueModelSelector.tsx:367-383`) — the latter currently omits the `Escape` its own footer hint (`IssueModelSelector.tsx:545`) promises, which cmdk now handles natively. Keep the surface-specific extras as parent-component structure: the loading/error placeholders, the "Use default" Override row, the Recent-models section (localStorage), the "Override active" note, and the "Per-stage overrides" disclosure (whose rows already use shared `ModelSelect` and were fixed by T-001). The Issue detail default-model popover is NOT restructured into `ModelSelect`; only its list layer swaps. Update `packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.test.tsx` in the same task.
acceptanceCriteria: The Issue detail default-model popover selects on click: `fireEvent.click(row)` invokes the issue-model patch path with the selected model id and closes the popover; `fireEvent.pointerDown(row)` no longer selects.

The popover exposes the same listbox/combobox semantics as the shared ModelSelect: list container `role="listbox"`, options `role="option"`, selected option `aria-selected="true"`, combobox input `aria-controls`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-activedescendant`.

Keyboard navigation matches the shared selector exactly: ↑/↓/`Home`/`End`/`Enter`/type-to-filter all work, and `Escape` now closes the popover (closing the gap where the footer hint promised Esc but the old `handleKeyDown` did not implement it).

Selecting a variant chip on the default-model popover persists model + variant through `patchIssueWorkflowDefinitionVar`; selecting a model row body persists the model with the default (no) variant; the "Use default" Override row and the Recent-models section continue to render and function.

Touch/pen scrolling over the popover list is unblocked (no `pointerdown`/`preventDefault` on selection) and the list applies `overscroll-y-contain` + sticky group headings identically to the shared selector.
The Override, Recent, and All-models sections render as labeled groups so assistive tech announces section context; loading and error states still render in the list area without throwing.

`IssueModelSelector.test.tsx` is updated: existing `fireEvent.pointerDown(row)` selection assertions flip to `fireEvent.click(row)`; new cases cover Escape-closes, `role="listbox"`/`role="option"`/`aria-selected`, and chip-click selection on the default-model popover.

Interaction is uniform across all four surfaces: opening the selector on Settings AI default, Settings AI per-stage, Issue config card default, Issue config card per-stage, Create Issue dialog, or Agent Profile editor exhibits identical click-to-select, touch scrolling, scroll containment, sticky headers, keyboard navigation, and combobox semantics.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` pass.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.tsx (default-model list ported to ModelOptionList; bespoke pointerdown + handleKeyDown deleted; loading/error/use-default/recent/per-stage extras preserved); packages/web/src/features/select-issue-model/ui/IssueModelSelector.test.tsx (flipped + new cases).
tasks.notes: Do NOT merge IssueModelSelector into ModelSelect — its loading/error/use-default/recent/fuzzysort/per-stage extras stay in the parent component (design Non-Goal); only the list layer swaps to the shared primitive so the spec's cross-surface uniformity is satisfied by construction (design Decision D2). Keep `filter={false}` + fuzzysort to avoid a search-quality regression on this surface (design Decision D6); unifying on cmdk's filter everywhere is an open question, not a requirement. This task is what fully satisfies the 'identical interaction across all four surfaces' requirement — T-001 already fixed the per-stage rows inside this component because they consume shared `ModelSelect`.

tasks.title: Behavioral verification of touch scroll, overscroll containment, sticky headers, and cross-surface parity
tasks.spec: specs/model-select/spec.md#Pointer handling does not suppress native scrolling
tasks.description: Human-in-the-loop review of the model-selector requirements that jsdom cannot exercise (no layout, no real touch/scroll): real touch/pen dragging scrolls the option list without selecting; scrolling to the top or bottom boundary does not chain to the page behind the popover; the current provider group header stays pinned while its group is in scroll view and swaps at the group boundary; the selected model is visually marked and options show pointer cursor + hover state; and the four surfaces (Settings AI default + per-stage, Issue config card default + per-stage, Create Issue dialog, Agent Profile editor) behave identically. Verify on a real browser using DevTools touch emulation (or a touch device) against each surface with a long model list. The jsdom-verifiable requirements (click-to-select, roles/aria, keyboard nav) are already covered by T-001/T-002 acceptance criteria and are not re-verified here.
acceptanceCriteria: Verification report records: on each of the four surfaces, touch/pen drag over the open list scrolls it without selecting any traversed option, and a tap on an option selects it and closes the popover.
Verification report records: scrolling the open list to its top boundary and continuing to scroll up does not move the page behind the popover; the same holds at the bottom boundary scrolling down.

Verification report records: with a provider group longer than the visible list area, scrolling within that group keeps its header pinned at the top; scrolling into the next group swaps the visible header.
Verification report records: options display a pointer cursor and a visible hover state; the currently-selected model is visually distinct from non-selected options on every surface.

Verification report records: interaction (click-to-select, touch scroll, scroll containment, sticky headers, keyboard navigation, combobox announcement via a screen reader if available) is identical across Settings AI default, Settings AI per-stage, Issue config card default, Issue config card per-stage, Create Issue dialog, and Agent Profile editor.
Any defect found is filed against the originating task (T-001 for the shared component and shared-ModelSelect surfaces; T-002 for the Issue default-model popover) before this review is marked passed.
tasks.output: Verification report covering touch-scroll no-select, overscroll containment at both boundaries, sticky provider headers, visual affordances, and cross-surface parity across all four model-selection surfaces.
tasks.notes: Required because jsdom has no layout — real touch scrolling, overscroll-behavior chaining, and sticky positioning cannot be exercised by `npm run test:run -w packages/web` (design.md Risks, 'jsdom cannot verify behavioral scroll/sticky/overscroll'). Consistent with `design/testing.md`'s separation of jsdom vs. browser-track concerns. A Playwright-style browser test is an open question (design.md Open Questions) but is NOT required for this review to pass; manual verification suffices.
